def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    div=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if set(r)=={5}][0]
    base=g[div+1:]
    oh=h-div-1
    # find base shape bbox
    cells=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(base) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v]
    bi0=min(i for i,j in cells); bi1=max(i for i,j in cells)
    bj0=min(j for i,j in cells); bj1=max(j for i,j in cells)
    bc=(bj0+bj1)/2
    # above shapes by color
    top=g[:div]
    colors=sorted({v for r in top for v in r if v},reverse=True)
    out=[list(r) for r in base]
    cur_top=bi0  # next shape bottom row = bi0-1
    for c in colors:
        cs=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(top) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==c]
        i0=min(i for i,j in cs); i1=max(i for i,j in cs)
        j0=min(j for i,j in cs); j1=max(j for i,j in cs)
        sh=i1-i0+1; sw=j1-j0+1
        rows=[[top[i][j] for j in range(j0,j1+1)] for i in range(i0,i1+1)]
        # place so bottom at cur_top-1, centered on bc
        start=cur_top-sh
        if start<0: continue  # crosses divider -> dropped
        joff=int(bc-(sw-1)/2+0.5)-0 if False else round(bc-(sw-1)/2)
        # keep within grid
        for ri,row in enumerate(rows):
            for rj,v in enumerate(row):
                if v:
                    jj=joff+rj
                    out[start+ri][jj]=v
        cur_top=start
    return out
